limits: For red wine, Grenache: at least 50%
For red wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 25%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A southern Rhône appellation for red wine, made its own AOC in 2006 as a Rhône cru after belonging to Côtes-du-Rhône Villages. Wines must contain. Some vineyards were once olive groves.
